summary: CONTEXT: multi-layer bugs live on contracts. Mapped three boundaries: cache vs links dict, SQLAlchemy pool vs memory creates, in-process queue vs analytics drain. Health of each part can be green while the handshake is wrong.
evidence: GET /r/{code} uses cache then links dict. Invalidate on PATCH + 60s TTL only. FIFO cap 10000 can drop dict entries the cache still holds.
GET /ready SELECT 1 on the pool (~4s 503 ConnectionTimeout) while POST /links 200 persisted=memory — pool green/red is not the write path.
enqueue_click to queue.Queue; analytics calls drain_once. Queue accept ≠ event visible. MAX_EVENTS 10000 silent drop. Same process as the DB pool (retry cascade).
Vocabulary: pool exhaustion = every checkout taken, API waits not crash. Cascade = retries on one path starve another.
